steps.note: Open the prepared awarded-flow event as the buyer.
Enable partial awarding so the line quantity can be split across vendors.
Navigate to the comparison grid containing the two vendor bids.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate six units of the line to Vendor B.
Allocate four units of the line to Vendor A.
Verify the full line is allocated to two vendors and the split proposal total is 6 × 90 plus 4 × 100.
Submit the split allocation as the award proposal.
Approve the submitted split award as the buyer.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase orders.
Verify that two purchase-order lines were created, corresponding to the two awarded vendors.
